input.rationale: Section 12.b gives us a TrueLink indemnity, but it is limited to TrueLink's breach of the Agreement or failure to perform its obligations; it contains no third-party intellectual property infringement indemnity for the Interface/hosting services, no indemnity for TrueLink's breach of law, no indemnity for unauthorized access to or disclosure of our data, and none for TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. No IP indemnity appears elsewhere (the only non-infringement covenants run from Client, e.g. §8 on Client Content and §2 on domain names), while §12.a imposes a very broad indemnity on us. Under the playbook the vendor must defend third-party IP claims and its own misconduct, so we expanded §12.b and added standard notice/control/cooperation procedure.

proposal.summary: Expand TrueLink's indemnity to cover third-party IP infringement, breach of law, unauthorized disclosure of Client data and gross negligence/willful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity in Section 12.b covers only its own breach of contract, while we give a broad indemnity in 12.a; we need TrueLink, as the party supplying the Interface and hosting, to defend us against third-party IP infringement claims and against its own unlawful conduct, data compromise and gross negligence. If TrueLink prefers, we can accept an IP indemnity with the usual exclusions (our content, modifications and specifications) and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.

ops.oldText: claim arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder.
ops.newText: claim arising out of (i) any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder; (ii) any allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any other software, materials or services provided by TrueLink infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret or other intellectual property right; (iii) any breach by TrueLink of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (iv) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content, Credit Data or other Client data caused by TrueLink; or (v) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of any claim for which indemnity is sought, and the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement of such claim (provided that no settlement imposing any obligation or admission on the indemnified party shall be made without its prior written consent), with the reasonable cooperation of the indemnified party at the indemnifying party's expense.
